name: RacingAIController
src_typeComment: Plug-and-play racing AI: assign an ordered waypoint path and this drives it — slowing into corners, catching up or backing off via rubber-banding, and auto-recovering if stuck — entirely through a StateMachine wired up internally, so no custom IState code is needed. Self-contained on purpose (it doesn't require SteeringAgent or WaypointPatrol) so dropping this one component in is enough.

src_serialized.name: waypoints
src_serialized.tooltip: Ordered path the AI drives around. Loops back to the first point after the last.

src_serialized.name: maxSpeed
src_serialized.tooltip: Top speed the AI accelerates towards on a straight.

src_serialized.name: acceleration
src_serialized.tooltip: How fast currentSpeed ramps towards its target speed, in units/sec^2.

src_serialized.name: turnSpeed
src_serialized.tooltip: How fast the AI's rotation turns to face its movement direction.

src_serialized.name: waypointReachDistance
src_serialized.tooltip: Distance from a waypoint that counts as reaching it.

src_serialized.name: corneringSlowdownStrength
src_serialized.tooltip: How much upcoming turn sharpness reduces speed. 0 = ignore corners entirely, 1 = full slowdown on sharp corners.

src_serialized.name: minCorneringSpeedFraction
src_serialized.tooltip: Minimum speed fraction of maxSpeed even on the sharpest corner.

src_serialized.name: rubberBandTarget
src_serialized.tooltip: If assigned, this AI speeds up when far from it and eases off when right on top of it, to stay competitive. Distance-based, not lap-progress-aware — good enough for a single rival without needing a shared race-progress tracker.

src_serialized.name: rubberBandMaxBoost
src_serialized.tooltip: Maximum speed multiplier adjustment applied by rubber-banding, as a fraction of maxSpeed (e.g. 0.25 = up to +/-25%).

src_serialized.name: rubberBandDistanceRange
src_serialized.tooltip: Distance from rubberBandTarget at which the boost/ease-off reaches its maximum.

src_serialized.name: stuckSpeedThreshold
src_serialized.tooltip: If speed stays below this for stuckTimeThreshold seconds, the AI reverses briefly to free itself.

src_serialized.name: stuckTimeThreshold
src_serialized.tooltip: How many consecutive seconds below stuckSpeedThreshold before recovery kicks in.

src_serialized.name: recoveryDuration
src_serialized.tooltip: How long the AI reverses for during recovery, in seconds.

src_members.sig: public UnityEvent OnLapCompleted = new UnityEvent(); // fires when the waypoint index wraps back to 0
src_members.name: UnityEvent
Finish
src_members.comment: Call this from a finish-line trigger (e.g. wired to a TriggerEventRelay's OnEnter) to stop the AI.
